errors.evidence: The y-axis is labeled "刻板印象" (Stereotype), not "刻板印象指数" (Stereotype Index). The description adds the word "index" which is an interpretation.
This phrasing is ambiguous. The chart has four groups of bars, with each group containing two bars representing two series. "两组柱状图" (two groups of bar charts) could be misinterpreted.
